ultimate-mega-minion-horde.description: Six armored Mega Minions take to the skies. The Hero form deploys six Hero Mega Minions; they choose different targets whenever enough enemies are available.

ultimate-lightning-storm.description: Six strike waves hit 1–3 randomly chosen enemies or towers in a storm cloud. Each wave arrives 0.9–2 seconds after the last. Its radius is 15% smaller than Graveyard.

ultimate-heal-spell.description: Place a healing field anywhere in the Arena. It has twice a Heal Spirit’s healing radius and lasts twice as long, restoring nearby friendly troops.

ultimate-balloon-parade.description: Six Balloons deploy in a broad Royal Recruits formation across your side of the Arena. Each carries its usual bomb and death damage.

ultimate-executioner-cage.description: A reinforced grey cage throws Executioner axes at up to three different enemies at once, with Inferno Tower range. When destroyed, it releases three Executioners.

ultimate-builder.description: Assign a Builder to one friendly building, excluding Princess and King Towers. One prevents lifetime decay; a second adds gradual healing. Maximum two Builders per building. Enemy attacks still damage it.

ultimate-magic-trio.description: Deploys an Ice Wizard, Electro Wizard and Wizard in a tight three-troop formation. Fire, frost and lightning arrive together.

ultimate-frostbite.description: Freezes a field 15% larger than Freeze and summons Ice Spirits throughout it using Graveyard-style spawning. Hero ability: spend 3 elixir to launch 10 Giant Snowballs at nearby positions.

ultimate-harvest.description: A pink field lasts 1.25× as long as Void with a 1.5× radius. Enemy troop deaths inside grant 0.1 elixir per Skeleton, 0.2 per Minion, Bat, Spirit or Goblin, 0.35 per Barbarian, and 1 for other troops. Pink beams mark each harvest.

ultimate-overcharged-tesla.description: An evolved Tesla that stays above ground. It charges and fires a Sparky-style blast instead of lightning bolts, with a harmless sky zap one second before each shot. No opening pulse.

ultimate-three-pekkas.description: Three heavily armored P.E.K.K.As deploy together. Three swords, three sets of glowing eyes, and a very expensive problem for the enemy.

ultimate-meteor-shower.description: An orange field 50% larger than Void rains eight Fireballs at random positions over 4.5 seconds. Each Fireball deals one third of normal Fireball damage.

ultimate-code-red.description: Launches 25 Rockets in rapid waves over 3 seconds, striking random locations across the enemy’s half of the Arena.

ultimate-royale-escort.description: Two Knights and a Prince lead a Royal Giant, with two Cannon Carts behind. One-cycle Evolution upgrades the Knights and Royal Giant and replaces the Prince with a Dark Prince.

ultimate-kings-dropoff.description: Four Royal Deliveries drop around a boxed Cannon Cart in a plus shape. The Cannon Cart lands in the centre while the recruits secure all four sides.

ultimate-elite-barbarians.description: Five Elite Barbarians deploy in the familiar Barbarians formation. Their fast movement and heavy swords make this a powerful group attack.

ultimate-elixir-witch.description: A Mother Witch who moves 5% slower and periodically summons middle-stage Elixir Golemites. Her kills turn enemy troops into tiny friendly Elixir Golemites instead of Hogs.

ultimate-unstable-egg.description: Place a Phoenix Egg on your side. On hatching: 30% Baby Dragon, 20% evolved Baby Dragon, 5% three Baby Dragons, or 45% a Goblin Demolisher-style explosion that damages both teams.

ultimate-fisherman.description: Hooks an enemy immediately on deployment when one is in hook range. Later hooks charge in half the normal time. Fish Slapping remains complimentary.

ultimate-bomb-squad.description: Two Bombers hide behind a Guard. The Bombers are invisible and cannot be targeted until their Guard falls; then they are revealed.
